The BioWare Community Live Team presents:
 
'Neverwinter Nights: Witch's Wake' v1.1
 
Designed by:
  Rob Bartel
 
Starting Level: 1
Number of Players: 1-6
 
The sounds of battle rage around you, ringing in the cold night air. You wake in a pool of your own blood to hear your prince's dying words. You're to deliver an important message to the king. Darkness overwhelms you... If only you could remember how to get home.
